name: Kelme
verdict: Owned by New Millennium Sports, S.L., a Spanish sportswear company based in Elche (Alicante). Nothing found.
note: Spanish sportswear brand; the AFC's Official Technical Sponsor and match-ball supplier, extended to 2029 and covering ACL Elite, Asian Cup 2027 and more (Kelme, 2024-11-18). Espanyol's kit maker since 2018-19 (La Grada, 2026-03-26). Kelme's legal notice names New Millennium Sports, S.L. as the owner of kelme.com; no public shareholder register found beyond the company itself.
